residencyRequirements.description: Either spouse must be an Australian citizen, domiciled in Australia, or ordinarily resident in Australia for at least 12 months immediately before the application (Family Law Act 1975 (Cth), s.39(3)).

waitingPeriod.description: No waiting period after filing. The 12-month separation period must be complete immediately before the application is filed (Family Law Act 1975 (Cth), s.48(2)). Divorce Order takes effect 1 month and 1 day after it is made (Family Law Act 1975 (Cth), s.55).

noFault.name: Irretrievable Breakdown (12-Month Separation)
noFault.description: The marriage has broken down irretrievably, demonstrated by the parties having lived separately and apart for a continuous period of not less than 12 months.

basic.name: Application for Divorce
basic.description: Initiates divorce proceedings under the Family Law Act 1975 (Cth). Filed in the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2).

basic.name: Affidavit — Proof of Separation
basic.description: Affidavit(s) explaining the separation — required only if the parties were separated under one roof for some or all of the 12-month separation period, or if the Court requests further evidence of separation

basic.name: Marriage Certificate
basic.description: Certified copy of the marriage certificate (or declaration if unavailable)

legalCitations.description: Federal statute — sole ground for divorce is irretrievable breakdown of marriage (s.48)

legalCitations.code: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Family Law) Rules 2021 (Cth)
legalCitations.description: Procedural rules for family law proceedings
Federal legislation governing child support assessment and collection
Repealed presumption of equal shared parental responsibility (s.61DA); reformed parenting provisions (in force 6 May 2024)
Codified property settlement process (s.79); added family violence and wastage factors; companion animal orders; abolished mandatory counselling for marriages under 2 years (in force 10 June 2025)

filingFees.notes: Fee effective 1 July 2025. Reduced fee of AUD $365 available for concession card holders (Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card, Commonwealth Seniors Health Card) or parties experiencing financial hardship. Apply using the Application for Reduction of Fees form.

childSupportGuidelines.notes: Child support is assessed by Services Australia (Child Support) based on both parents' incomes, the cost of children, and the care percentage each parent provides.

spousalSupportGuidelines.notes: Spousal maintenance is discretionary. The court considers the applicant's ability to adequately support themselves and the respondent's ability to pay (s.75(2) factors).

effectiveDateRule: The Divorce Order takes effect 1 month and 1 day after the order is made (Family Law Act 1975 (Cth), s.55). The parties may not remarry until the order takes effect.
certificateNote: A Divorce Order (which serves as proof of divorce) can be obtained from the court registry after the order takes effect.
